scope: Unchanged MIT Windows SDK scrollbar state inspector translated into Wasm inside the browser with native Wine base DLLs. Nine GUI stages in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes verify actual getter values, clamping, signed limits, legacy sizes and compiled custom-window callbacks. API state and forwarding are covered; standard scrollbar widgets, thumb tracking and universal Windows/DLL compatibility remain unfinished.
oracleReference: Wine 11 desktop x86 macOS; native Windows SDK scrollbar API captures
